findings.title: configuration.md's hook-upgrade route is refused by `orchid init` on any existing run
the merge warning's live-task and integration-branch exemptions are asserted vacuously
a self-hosted repo gets the containment warning on every merge, with no exemption or off switch

summary: The pre-push refusal cannot reach any already-initialized repository via the path the diff documents, and the exemption logic that keeps the merge warning readable is only covered for archived runs.
